title: Drawing on the Powers of Heaven Chapter 2: Faith, the Key to Excellence (Part 2)
summary: This message concludes chapter two of Grant von Harrison's book, establishing faith as the foundational key to personal excellence. It highlights how personal righteousness binds the Lord to fulfill His promises and unpacks the true nature of 'desire' as a deep, convicting motivation rather than a passive wish. Drawing on the scriptural examples of Alma and Ammon's intense missionary struggles, the text demonstrates that deep desires, fueled by tightly disciplined thoughts, are required to unlock divine intervention in both spiritual and everyday secular pursuits.
